title: Account access and password reset
text: For this fictional demo, open Account Settings and select Reset Password. Never send a password to a support agent.

title: Supported document upload formats
text: This fictional FAQ describes PDF and DOCX uploads. Check that a file is readable before importing it. This demo does not implement uploads.

title: Privacy and sensitive customer data
text: Use synthetic data in demonstrations. Do not upload customer records, passwords or confidential employer documents to a public project.

title: Resume export and editable copies
text: Keep an editable resume and a separate application copy. This retrieval demo does not generate or export PDFs.
